archiveTitle: Morning Brief | The Witcher 3 Expansion Reveals Letten and Story Details

entries.headline: The Witcher 3 Expansion “Songs of the Past” Reveals Letten and Story-Focused Open-World Details
entries.summary: Xbox Wire played roughly 45 minutes of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion “Songs of the Past.” Developed by Fool’s Theory with CD Projekt Red, the expansion is set in Dandelion’s homeland of Letten, where Geralt investigates the bard’s family past and a mystery tied to the “Garden of Thorns.” Fool’s Theory describes Letten as a full open world and has upgraded NPC systems to make the region feel more lived-in.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire primary preview directly supports the hands-on duration, development partners, Letten setting, quest clues, open-world scope, and NPC-system description. The Simplified Chinese game title in Canonical was normalized separately from the official Steam store.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire published the preview at 2026-08-29T12:19:42Z, or 20:19 Beijing time on August 29, inside the fixed window of August 29 17:00 exclusive through August 30 10:10 inclusive.
